context: Asuka and Riku talk about nature on a clear day.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: nature chat; vocabulary (晴れ/桜/触れ/世界中/緑) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日は、よく晴れていますね。
lines.style: bright teen boy voice, soft warm cheerful engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、桜も緑も、輝いていますね。
lines.en: Yes, the blossoms and greenery are shining.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm gentle clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 葉に触れると、ひんやりしますね。
lines.en: Touching the leaves, they feel cool.
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 自然に触れるのは、心に良いですよ。
lines.en: Touching nature is good for the heart.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm gentle clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 世界中に、こんな緑があるんですか?
lines.en: Is there greenery like this worldwide?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 世界中で、緑は形を変えてあります。
lines.en: Worldwide, greenery exists in changing forms.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm gentle clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 晴れた日の桜、最高ですね。
lines.en: Cherry blossoms on a clear day are the best.
lines.style: delighted teen boy voice, soft warm bright throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 自然に触れる時間を、大切にね。
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm gentle closing clarity throughout
